title: 凌峰之平行空间第一章 山顶异光第二章 错位的圣诞
lines: 第一章：山顶异光
暮色像一块浸了墨的绒布，正缓缓罩住上海的轮廓。凌峰站在“聚福楼”的阁楼窗边，指尖无意识地划过窗棂上那道浅痕——那是半年前送别郎斯星人时，飞船尾焰的余温灼出的印记。
楼下传来妻子刘佳琪的声音，带着江南女子特有的温软：“凌峰，下来吃饭了，国强哥带了醉蟹来。”
凌峰应了一声，转身下楼。木质楼梯在脚下发出轻微的“吱呀”声，这声音他听了近十年，从接手这家祖传的中餐厅开始，就成了生活里最安稳的背景音。
堂屋里，刘佳琪正系着围裙往桌上端菜，她的堂兄刘国强坐在八仙桌旁，一身警服还没来得及换下，手里把玩着个搪瓷杯，杯身上“为人民服务”的字样有些褪色。见凌峰下来，刘国强抬头笑了笑：“妹夫，最近店里生意怎么样？前阵子局里忙，一直没顾得上过来看看。”
“挺好的，”凌峰拉开椅子坐下，给刘国强倒了杯黄酒，“就是老样子，熟客多，图个踏实。”
刘佳琪端着最后一盘炒青菜上桌，嗔怪道：“哥，你也是，来了就不能先把警服换了？搞得跟审案子似的。”
“这不是刚从所里过来嘛，”刘国强哈哈一笑，夹起一只醉蟹，“说起来，最近城郊不太平，总有人说看到奇怪的光，半夜里亮得跟白天似的，局里接到好几个报案了，查了几天也没头绪。”
凌峰的手顿了顿。半年前，郎斯星人的飞船就是在城郊那片山区降落的，当时那道划破夜空的蓝光，至今想起来仍觉得像场不真切的梦。郎斯星人说他们是星际旅行者，因飞船故障迫降，修复后便匆匆离去，临走时留下句话：“宇宙的缝隙比你们想象的更薄，偶尔会透出光来。”
当时只当是外星谚语，此刻听刘国强说起，凌峰心里莫名一动。
“是哪片山区？”他问。
“就是沈家浜那边的山顶，”刘国强咂了口酒，“荒得很，除了几个护林员，平时没人去。我看八成是有人搞恶作剧，或者是什么自然现象，过阵子就消停了。”
刘佳琪给凌峰夹了块红烧肉：“管他什么光，跟咱们没关系，吃饭吧。”
凌峰没再追问，心里却像被什么东西轻轻挠了一下。
接下来的三天，日子过得平静无波。刘国强第二天一早就回了局里，临走时还笑着叮嘱凌峰看好店，别让刘佳琪操心。凌峰照旧每天早起去后厨验货，中午忙完一波客人，下午就在阁楼里看书，傍晚站在窗边看夕阳把对面的老墙染成金红色。
直到第三天傍晚，异变突生。
那天收工早，凌峰和刘佳琪沿着河边散步，晚风带着水汽拂过脸颊，很是惬意。忽然，西北方向的夜空亮了一下，不是闪电那种瞬间的刺眼，而是像有块巨大的蓝宝石被缓缓擦亮，柔和却又极具穿透力的光芒，在云层后若隐若现。
“那是什么？”刘佳琪停下脚步，指着天空，眼里满是惊讶。
凌峰的心跳猛地加速。那光芒的质感，和半年前郎斯星人飞船的光太像了。
“去看看？”他脱口而出。
刘佳琪犹豫了一下：“国强哥不是说那边荒吗？而且天都快黑了。”
“就去山脚看看，不往上爬，”凌峰望着那片光，心里像有个声音在催促，“说不定是……老熟人呢？”
他没明说“老熟人”指什么，但刘佳琪瞬间懂了。半年前送别时的场景浮现眼前，她点了点头：“那开车去，早点回来。”
车子沿着国道往城郊开，越靠近沈家浜，天空的光芒就越清晰。起初只是云层透出的微光，后来竟凝成一道光柱，直直地从山顶垂落，像是在天地间架了座光桥。路上开始出现零星的车辆，都是被这异象吸引来的，有人摇下车窗拍照，有人在路边议论纷纷。
“好像比刚才亮了。”刘佳琪看着仪表盘上的时间，已经晚上八点多了，“要不就在这儿停吧，前面好像没路了。”
车子确实没法再往前开，前方是条仅容一人通过的山路，被闻讯赶来的村民围了个半圈，都在仰头往山顶看。凌峰把车停在路边，拉着刘佳琪挤到人群前面。
山顶的光此刻已经亮得惊人，那道光柱周围，隐约能看到一个巨大的轮廓，像是被光晕包裹的圆盘，边缘有细碎的光点在流转，不像是任何人类已知的飞行器。
“我的天……那是什么东西？”旁边有人喃喃自语，声音里带着恐惧。
“会不会是外星人？”另一个人接话，语气里半是害怕半是兴奋。
凌峰紧握着刘佳琪的手，手心有些出汗。他确定那不是郎斯星人的飞船，郎斯星人的飞船是银灰色的流线型，而眼前这个，更像是悬浮在空中的巨大晶体，散发着圣洁又诡异的光。
就在这时，光柱忽然收缩了一下，紧接着，一道更亮的光束从圆盘中心射向地面，正好落在山路上方不远处。人群发出一阵惊呼，下意识地往后退。
“佳琪，我们要不要……”凌峰想说“要不要回去”，却被刘佳琪拽了一下。

Chapter 1: Strange light on the top of the mountain
The dusk is like a piece of velvet soaked in ink, slowly covering the outline of Shanghai. Ling Feng stood by the attic window of the "Jufu Tower", and his fingertips unconsciously traced the shallow mark on the window lattice - it was the mark left by the residual heat of the spacecraft's tail flame when he bid farewell to the Langs star half a year ago.
The voice of his wife Liu Jiaqi came from downstairs, with the tenderness unique to Jiangnan women: "Ling Feng, come down for dinner. Brother Guoqiang has brought drunken crabs."
Ling Feng responded, turned around and went downstairs. The wooden stairs made a slight creaking sound under his feet. He had listened to this sound for nearly ten years. Ever since he took over this ancestral Chinese restaurant, it had become the most stable background sound in his life.
In the main room, Liu Jiaqi was wearing an apron and serving food to the table. Her cousin Liu Guoqiang was sitting at the Eight Immortals table. He had not had time to change out of his police uniform. He was playing with an enamel cup in his hand. The words "Serve the People" on the cup were somewhat faded. Seeing Ling Feng coming down, Liu Guoqiang raised his head and smiled: "Brother-in-law, how is the business in the store lately? The office has been busy a while ago, so I haven't had the time to come over and take a look."
"It's pretty good." Ling Feng pulled out the chair and sat down, pouring a glass of rice wine for Liu Guoqiang. "It's just the same as before. There are many regular customers, so I want to be at ease."
Liu Jiaqi brought the last plate of fried vegetables to the table and said angrily: "Brother, you too, can't you change your police uniform first when you come? It's like trying a case."
"Didn't he just come from the police station?" Liu Guoqiang laughed and picked up a drunken crab. "Speaking of which, the suburbs of the city have not been peaceful recently. Some people always say they see strange lights, which are as bright as daytime in the middle of the night. The bureau has received several reports, and after several days of investigation, they still have no clue."
Ling Feng's hand paused. Half a year ago, the Langsi star's spaceship landed in the mountainous area on the outskirts of the city. The blue light that cut through the night sky at that time still feels like an unreal dream when I think about it. The Langsi people said that they were interstellar travelers who made an emergency landing due to a spacecraft malfunction. After repairs, they left in a hurry. Before leaving, they left a message: "The gap in the universe is thinner than you think, and occasionally light will shine through."
At that time, he just thought it was an alien proverb. Now that he heard Liu Guoqiang talking about it, Ling Feng's heart moved inexplicably.
"Which mountainous area is it?" he asked.
"It's the top of the mountain over at Shenjiabang," Liu Guoqiang sipped his wine. "It's very deserted. Except for a few forest rangers, no one usually goes there. I think it's probably someone playing a prank or some natural phenomenon, and it will stop after a while."
Liu Jiaqi gave Ling Feng a piece of braised pork: "What the hell, it has nothing to do with us, let's eat."
Ling Feng didn't ask any more questions, but his heart felt like it was lightly scratched by something.
The next three days passed uneventfully. Liu Guoqiang returned to the bureau early the next morning. Before leaving, he smiled and told Ling Feng to watch the store and not let Liu Jiaqi worry. Ling Feng still got up early every day to inspect the goods in the back kitchen. He finished a wave of customers at noon, read in the attic in the afternoon, and stood by the window in the evening to watch the sunset dye the old wall opposite golden red.
It wasn't until the evening of the third day that a sudden change occurred.
Work ended early that day. Ling Feng and Liu Jiaqi took a walk along the river. The evening breeze brought moisture to their cheeks, which was very pleasant. Suddenly, the night sky in the northwest lit up. It was not the instant glare of lightning, but like a huge sapphire being slowly polished. The soft but penetrating light loomed behind the clouds.
"What is that?" Liu Jiaqi stopped and pointed at the sky, her eyes full of surprise.
Ling Feng's heartbeat accelerated sharply. The texture of the light was very similar to the light from the Langs Star spacecraft half a year ago.
"Go take a look?" he blurted out.
Liu Jiaqi hesitated for a moment: "Didn't Brother Guoqiang say it's deserted over there? And it's almost dark."
"Just go to the foot of the mountain and have a look, don't climb up," Ling Feng looked at the light, as if a voice in his heart was urging him, "Maybe... an old acquaintance?"
He didn't say clearly what "old acquaintance" meant, but Liu Jiaqi understood instantly. The scene of farewell half a year ago came to mind, and she nodded: "Then drive and come back early."
The car drove along the national highway toward the outskirts of the city. The closer it got to Shenjiabang, the clearer the light in the sky became. At first it was just a glimmer of light from the clouds, but later it condensed into a pillar of light that hung straight down from the top of the mountain, like a bridge of light between heaven and earth. Sporadic vehicles began to appear on the road, all attracted by this vision. Some people rolled down their windows to take pictures, and some were talking on the roadside.
"It seems to be brighter than before." Liu Jiaqi looked at the time on the dashboard. It was already past eight o'clock in the evening. "Why don't we stop here. There seems to be no road ahead."
The car really couldn't drive any further. In front of it was a mountain road that could only be passed by one person. The villagers who came after hearing the news formed a half circle and looked up at the top of the mountain. Ling Feng parked the car on the side of the road and pushed Liu Jiaqi to the front of the crowd.
The light on the top of the mountain was already astonishingly bright at the moment. Around the light pillar, a huge outline could be vaguely seen, like a disk wrapped in a halo, with tiny light spots flowing around the edge. It did not look like any aircraft known to mankind.
"Oh my God...what is that?" Someone next to him muttered to himself, with fear in his voice.
"Could it be an alien?" Another person answered, his tone half scared and half excited.
Ling Feng held Liu Jiaqi's hand tightly, his palms a little sweaty. He was sure that it was not the Langs star's spaceship. The Langs star's spaceship was silver-gray and streamlined, and the one in front of him was more like a huge crystal suspended in the air, emitting a holy and strange light.
At this moment, the light column suddenly shrank, and then, a brighter beam of light shot from the center of the disk to the ground, landing not far above the mountain road. The crowd exclaimed and subconsciously stepped back.
"Jiaqi, should we..." Ling Feng wanted to say "should we go back?" but was pulled by Liu Jiaqi.
title_en: Lingfeng: Parallel Space Chapter 1: Strange Light on the Mountain Top Chapter 2: Misplaced Christmas
